function.description: This function constructs a proxy manager. It initializes the proxy manager's properties, handles error conditions, and sets the proxy manager's context.

parameters.name: apt
parameters.description: Pointer to the apartment structure where the object was unmarshaled into

parameters.name: sorflags
parameters.description: The STDOBJREF flags stored in the proxy manager

parameters.name: oxid
parameters.description: The source apartment of the object

parameters.name: oid

parameters.name: proxy_manager
parameters.description: Double pointer to the proxy manager structure to be constructed

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function execution. It returns S_OK if the function executes successfully, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, or an error code obtained from HRESULT_FROM_WIN32(GetLastError()) if mutex creation fails

function.name: proxy_manager_set_context
function.description: This function sets the context for a proxy manager. It uses an interlocked compare-exchange operation to ensure thread safety when updating the context. If the destination context data is not null, it also updates the destination context data using an interlocked exchange operation.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: Pointer to the proxy manager whose context is to be set

parameters.name: dest_context
parameters.description: The new context to be set

parameters.name: dest_context_data
parameters.description: Pointer to the new context data to be set

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: proxy_manager_query_local_interface
function.description: This function queries a local interface of a proxy manager. It checks if the requested interface ID matches any of the known interfaces (IUnknown, IMultiQI, IMarshal, IClientSecurity). If a match is found, it returns a pointer to the interface and increments the reference count. If no match is found, it tries to find the interface proxy. If the interface proxy is found, it returns a pointer to the interface and increments the reference count. If no interface or interface proxy is found, it returns E_NOINTERFACE.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: Pointer to the proxy manager structure

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the interface ID to query

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer that receives the interface pointer if the function is successful

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function execution. It returns S_OK if the function is successful, otherwise it returns E_NOINTERFACE

function.name: proxy_manager_create_ifproxy
function.description: This function creates an interface proxy for a given interface identifier, and associates it with a proxy manager and a channel buffer. If the interface identifier is not IUnknown, it also connects the proxy buffer to the channel.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: Pointer to the proxy manager

parameters.name: stdobjref
parameters.description: Pointer to the standard object reference

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Interface identifier

parameters.name: channel
parameters.description: Pointer to the RPC channel buffer

parameters.name: iif_out
parameters.description: Pointer to the output interface proxy

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails, or other error codes if there are problems in creating the proxy or connecting the proxy buffer to the channel.

function.name: proxy_manager_find_ifproxy
function.description: This function searches for an interface proxy in the proxy manager's list of interfaces. If found, it assigns the interface proxy to the provided pointer and returns S_OK, otherwise it returns E_NOINTERFACE.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: Pointer to the proxy manager structure

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Interface identifier to search for

parameters.name: ifproxy_found
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to receive the found interface proxy

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the interface proxy is found, otherwise returns E_NOINTERFACE

function.name: proxy_manager_disconnect
function.description: This function disconnects a proxy manager. It enters a critical section, checks if the SORFP_NOLIFETIMEMGMT flag is not set, and if so, disconnects all interfaces. It then sets the parent to NULL and leaves the critical section.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: Pointer to the proxy manager to be disconnected

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: proxy_manager_get_remunknown
function.description: This function is used to get the IRemUnknown interface from the proxy manager. If the interface is not available, it attempts to unmarshal it.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: Pointer to the proxy manager from which the IRemUnknown interface is to be retrieved.

parameters.name: remunk
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to IRemUnknown. This function will set it to point to the IRemUnknown interface retrieved from the proxy manager.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, S_FALSE if the operation is not successful or if lifetime management is not required, and CO_E_NOTINITIALIZED if the apartment is not initialized.

function.name: proxy_manager_addref_if_alive
function.description: This function checks if the proxy manager is alive (not about to be destroyed) and if so, increments its reference count.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: A pointer to the proxy manager whose reference count is to be incremented if it is alive.

function.return_type: LONG, represents the new reference count if the proxy manager is alive, or 0 if it is about to be destroyed.

function.name: proxy_manager_destroy
function.description: This function is responsible for destroying a proxy manager. It removes the proxy manager from the list of proxy objects in the apartment, destroys all of the interface proxies, releases the IRemUnknown interface if it exists, frees the memory allocated for the OXID resolver, deletes the critical section, closes the remoting mutex handle, and finally frees the memory allocated for the proxy manager itself.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the proxy manager to be destroyed.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: find_proxy_manager
function.description: This function searches for a proxy manager in an apartment based on the provided OXID and OID. If found and the proxy manager is alive, it sets the found proxy manager to the proxy_found parameter and returns TRUE. Otherwise, it returns FALSE.

parameters.name: apt
parameters.description: Pointer to the apartment structure where the search is performed

parameters.name: oxid
parameters.description: The OXID of the proxy manager to find

parameters.name: oid
parameters.description: The OID of the proxy manager to find

parameters.name: proxy_found
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to a proxy manager structure. If a matching proxy manager is found and is alive, this parameter is set to point to it

function.return_type: BOOL, returns TRUE if a matching and alive proxy manager is found, otherwise returns FALSE

function.name: apartment_disconnectproxies
